auth_details: Development keys auto-issue and deactivate every 24h; personal keys require product registration (private use); production keys need app approval. Auth via X-Riot-Token header or api_key query. VALORANT has separate product/approval restrictions.
free_tier_limits: Development keys: free, deactivate every 24h, low limits. Personal keys: free after product registration for private use. Production keys: free after approval for public apps, higher limits. All via developer.riotgames.com.
rate_limits: Personal keys: 20 req/s and 100 req/2min per region. Production starting limits: 500 req/10s and 30,000 req/10min per region; method/service limits may also apply (see developer portal).
description: Official Riot Games API for League of Legends, VALORANT, TFT, LoR, and more: match history, player stats, ranked ladders, live game data, account identity via regional routing. Free keys from the developer portal with rate limits; production needs approval.
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor correct — docs distinguish development (24h), personal (registered private), production (approved); VALORANT restrictions apply. free_tier_limits: auditor correct — same key-type split. rate_limits: auditor correct — 20/1s + 100/2min personal; 500/10s + 30k/10min production starting (per region). Evidence: https://developer.riotgames.com/docs/portal and https://developer.riotgames.com/docs/lol
